subject: Nimbus Health — portal inventory & proof handoff
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@vendr.com, support@whistic.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal access + initial inventory for Whistic/Vendr onboarding

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the vendor security portal onboarding for Redwood as part of our procurement run for a pilot. Our security team needs: a scoped inventory of where Redwood stores customer data, an S3 manifest (or equivalent) showing objects you control for logs/evidence, and proof of KMS key rotation for the past 12 months. We also want the CAIQ mapping sheet for your current service perimeter to import into our Whistic profile.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the single point for evidence handoff? We'd like a short mutual action plan (MAP) for the next two weeks with dates for:
- S3 manifest delivery
- CAIQ/Answers import or spreadsheet
- SOC 2 evidence snapshot (latest in-scope reports or portal proof)

We can provision a vendor user in Whistic and give temporary access to Vendr if that speeds things up.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Sara Kim
Vendor Security Lead, Nimbus Health
Attached: none (we'll accept links or uploads)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access + initial inventory for Whistic/Vendr onboarding

Sara — thanks for the clear ask.

I'll own the MAP and coordinate the evidence handoff. Naomi will assemble the S3 manifest and KMS rotation artifacts; Mateo will prepare the CAIQ export and the short SOC 2 readiness summary; Aditya will coordinate the Whistic/Vendr account provisioning and can accept the invite you send.

Proposed MAP (two-week window):
1) 2027-08-17 — deliver S3 manifest CSV + signed KMS rotation statement (Naomi)
2) 2027-08-19 — CAIQ export (spreadsheet) + mapping notes (Mateo)
3) 2027-08-20 — Whistic account invite accepted; initial profile upload (Aditya)
4) 2027-08-23 — follow-up call to close any gaps and hand off final access (Markus)

If that timeline works, we'll upload artifacts to the Drive link below and paste the Whistic/Vendr upload links in this thread. One question: for the S3 manifest, do you prefer a full object-level listing, or just the manifest of evidence buckets/paths and a sample object listing?

I'll hold 30 minutes on 2027-08-23 in case we need the follow-up review.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nimbushealth.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access + initial inventory for Whistic/Vendr onboarding

Sara — sending the first artifacts inline and via Drive:

Attached: nimbus_s3_manifest_20270815.csv (manifest: bucket,path,prefix,object_count,last_modified_sample)
Attached: kms_rotation_statement_20270815.pdf (signed statement — key IDs, rotation dates, KMS access log pointers)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-nimbus-evidence-pack

Notes:
- We provided a manifest of in-scope evidence buckets and a 100-object sample per bucket instead of a full object list to avoid overly large exports. If you require a full per-object ledger for an audit, let us know and we'll schedule an export (estimate 24–36 hours).
- KMS rotation statement includes last 12 months with rotation timestamps and the ARN list. We cannot provide raw KMS logs; instead we provide signed statements and CloudTrail pointers (filtered) per your request.
- Mateo's CAIQ spreadsheet (to follow in next email) has column-level notes where Redwood's runtime telemetry is considered out-of-scope for this profile.

Let us know if Whistic needs account-level SSO provisioning or if a vendor user is preferred — Aditya can accept whichever flow you prefer.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@vendr.com, support@whistic.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access + initial inventory for Whistic/Vendr onboarding

Naomi — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround. The sample object listing and the signed KMS statement are fine for initial review. We'll accept the Drive link and proceed to import the CAIQ rows when you send them.

For Whistic we'd like a vendor user so we can keep access scoped to the profile only; please send the invite to vendor-access@whistic.com and cc onboarding@vendr.com. Once Aditya confirms the invite flow we'll start the import.

I'll schedule the 30-minute follow-up for 2027-08-23 10:00 PT. If anything else comes up before then, please reply here.

Appreciate the speed — Sara
Sara Kim
Vendor Security Lead, Nimbus Health
summary: Onboarding MAP for Nimbus Health: deliver S3 manifest sample, signed KMS rotation statement, CAIQ export; vendor user preferred for Whistic; follow-up call scheduled.
